name: Gajakesari Yoga
formation: Jupiter in a Kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from the Moon.
effect: Lasting reputation, polite/generous nature, administrative position or judicial authority.
modern_interpretation: Executive leadership, public administration, judicial/legal authority.
neutralization: Weakened if Jupiter or Moon own 6th/8th/11th or are afflicted by Saturn/Rahu.
additional_info: Operates strongly during Jupiter or Moon Dasa/Bhukti.

name: Sunapha Yoga
formation: Planets other than the Sun occupy the 2nd house from the Moon.
effect: Self-earned wealth, high intelligence, good reputation, financial security.
modern_interpretation: Entrepreneurial success, self-made financial assets, commercial skills.
neutralization: Cancelled if forming planet is debilitated, combust, or afflicted by Rahu/Kethu.
additional_info: Nature of wealth depends on specific planet in 2nd from Moon.

name: Anapha Yoga
formation: Planets other than the Sun occupy the 12th house from the Moon.
effect: Well-formed body, generous disposition, self-respect, spiritual inclination.
modern_interpretation: Philanthropy, overseas ventures, balanced temperament, spiritual maturity.
neutralization: Impaired if 12th planet is severely afflicted or debilitated.
additional_info: Encourages healthy spending and charitable deeds.

name: Dhurdhura Yoga
formation: Planets other than the Sun occupy both 2nd and 12th houses from the Moon.
effect: Bountiful wealth, high societal standing, conveyances, generous temperament.
modern_interpretation: Multi-stream income, high mobility, luxury vehicle ownership.
neutralization: Neutralized if forming planets are weak, combust, or hemmed by Rahu/Kethu.
additional_info: Acts as combination of Sunapha and Anapha.

name: Kemadruma Yoga
formation: No planets occupy the 2nd or 12th houses from the Moon.
effect: Poverty, mental sorrow, dependence on others, unrighteous actions, instability.
modern_interpretation: Financial instability, feeling isolated, career fluctuations, emotional distress.
neutralization: Kemadruma Bhanga occurs if Kendras from Lagna/Moon are occupied by planets or Moon aspected by benefics.
additional_info: Check Kemadruma Bhanga rules carefully as full Kemadruma is rare.

name: Chandra Mangala Yoga
formation: Conjunction or mutual aspect between Moon and Mars.
effect: Earnings through trade, aggressive commercial enterprise, or catering to base needs.
modern_interpretation: Real estate trading, commercial sales, finance, hospitality business.
neutralization: If Mars or Moon afflicted by 8th/12th lords, gains may come unethically.
additional_info: Highly favorable for wealth in 2nd, 9th, 10th, or 11th house.

name: Adhi Yoga
formation: Benefics occupy 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Moon.
effect: Polite nature, administrative authority, immunity from enemies, long life.
modern_interpretation: Corporate governance, strategic leadership, diplomatic immunity.
neutralization: Weakened if benefics are combust or aspected by potent malefics.
additional_info: Evaluated from Lagna or Moon; results scale with benefic participation.

name: Chatussagara Yoga
formation: All four Kendra houses (1, 4, 7, 10) occupied by planets.
effect: High reputation, good health, widespread influence, lasting prosperity.
modern_interpretation: Global recognition, well-rounded achievements, strong foundation.
neutralization: Diminished if planets in Kendras are predominantly debilitated or combust.
additional_info: Creates a stable, robust astrological grid.

name: Vasumathi Yoga
formation: Benefics occupy Upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11) from Lagna or Moon.
effect: Absolute financial independence, immense accumulated wealth, self-made fortune.
modern_interpretation: Financial autonomy, high net worth, successful investment portfolio.
neutralization: Weakened if benefics are debilitated or afflicted by Saturn/Rahu.
additional_info: Upachayas represent growth over time; wealth accumulates steadily.

name: Rajalakshana Yoga
formation: Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, and Moon occupy Lagna or Kendras.
effect: Attractive appearance, high dignity, royal demeanor, societal respect.
modern_interpretation: Public charisma, celebrity status, high social standing.
neutralization: Neutralized if benefics are heavily afflicted by Sun/Mars/Saturn.
additional_info: Emphasizes personal magnetism and regal presence.

name: Vanchana Chora Bheethi Yoga
formation: Lagna occupied by malefic with Gulika in 5th/9th; or Gulika with Kendra lords; or Lagna lord with Rahu/Saturn/Kethu.
effect: Persistent suspicion, fear of theft/swindling, financial losses through deceit.
modern_interpretation: Cyber-fraud vulnerability, paranoia in partnerships, risk of financial scam.
neutralization: Mitigated if Lagna lord receives Jupiter aspect or Vaiseshikamsa.
additional_info: Evaluates psychological security and loss through swindling.

name: Sakata Yoga
formation: Moon in 6th, 8th, or 12th house from Jupiter.
effect: Alternating financial gains and losses, poverty, stubbornness, misery.
modern_interpretation: Cyclical financial volatility, career ups and downs, economic unpredictability.
neutralization: Cancelled if Moon is in a Kendra from Lagna (Sakata Bhanga).
additional_info: Manifests during transit shifts of Moon relative to Jupiter.

name: Amala Yoga
formation: A benefic planet occupies the 10th house from Lagna or Moon.
effect: Spotless character, ethical prosperity, enduring fame, philanthropic deeds.
modern_interpretation: High professional ethics, corporate responsibility, unblemished public record.
neutralization: Weakened if the benefic planet is aspected by 8th/12th malefic lords.
additional_info: Ensures clean reputation regardless of wealth scale.

name: Parvata Yoga

neutralization: Neutralized if Lagna lord is debilitated or combust.

name: Matrudeerghayur Yoga 2
formation: 4th lord in Kendra combined with Jupiter.
effect: Long, prosperous life for mother.

name: Matrunasa Yoga 2
formation: 4th house occupied by Mars and Saturn without benefic aspect.
effect: Early death or separation from mother.

name: Matrugami Yoga
formation: Moon/Venus in Kendra afflicted by malefics with malefic in 4th.

name: Sahodareesangama Yoga
formation: 7th lord and Venus in 4th house afflicted by potent malefics.

name: Kapata Yoga 2

effect: Guarded intention, manipulative behavior.
neutralization: Mitigated by Jupiter aspect.

name: Kapata Yoga 3
formation: Gulika placed in 4th house without benefic aspect.
effect: Deceitful nature, hidden agenda.

name: Nishkapata Yoga 1

name: Nishkapata Yoga 2
formation: 4th lord combined with Jupiter in Kendra.
effect: Unblemished integrity, honest disposition.
neutralization: Weakened if 4th lord is combust.

name: Matru Satrutwa Yoga

name: Vahana Yoga 1

name: Vahana Yoga 2

effect: Luxury fleet ownership, high-end vehicles.

formation: Rahu in 5th house aspected by Mars.
effect: Loss of children due to serpent curse/ancestral affliction.

name: Sarpasapa Yoga 2

effect: Childlessness or reproductive complications.

name: Sarpasapa Yoga 3

effect: Delay or loss of progeny.
neutralization: Cancelled by strong Jupiter aspect.

name: Sarpasapa Yoga 4
formation: Jupiter combined with Rahu and Mars in 5th house.
effect: Obstacles in lineage perpetuation.
neutralization: Mitigated by benefic aspect.

name: Pitrusapa Sutakshaya Yoga
formation: Sun debilitated or in Saturnian Navamsas in 5th house.
effect: Loss of children due to father's wrath/curse.
neutralization: Cancelled if Sun receives Sun-dispositor aspect.

name: Matrusapa Sutakshaya Yoga
formation: Exchange between 5th and 8th lords with Moon in 6th house.
effect: Loss of children due to mother's curse/grief.
neutralization: Mitigated by Jupiter aspect.

name: Bhratrusapa Sutakshaya Yoga

formation: 5th lord in 8th house combined with Saturn.
effect: Loss or health struggle of child at specific age.

formation: Jupiter in Mrudwamsa in own Navamsa or Gopuramsa aspected by benefic.

formation: Jupiter and Venus in 5th house, or Mercury in 5th house.
effect: Immense happiness, peace, and pride through children.

formation: 7th lord or Venus aspected by or combined with Jupiter or Mercury.

formation: 7th lord placed in 4th house combined with Venus.
effect: Specific intense sexual passion and physical intimacy.
neutralization: Mitigated by Saturn aspect.

name: Bhagya Yoga
formation: Strong benefic placed in 1st, 3rd, or 5th house aspecting 9th house.
effect: Extreme good fortune, wealth, effortless success, high luck.

name: Jananatpurvam Pitru Marana Yoga
formation: Sun in 6/8/12, 8th lord in 9th, 12th lord in 1st, 6th lord in 5th.
effect: Posthumous birth (father's death prior to birth).
neutralization: Cancelled if Sun receives strong dispositor aspect.

name: Dhatrutwa Yoga
formation: Exalted 9th lord aspected by benefic, with benefic in 9th house.
effect: Deep generosity, large scale philanthropy, charitable institutions.
neutralization: Weakened if 9th lord is combust.

name: Apakeerti Yoga
formation: Sun and Saturn in 10th house in malefic Navamsas or aspected by malefics.
effect: Bad reputation, public scandal, fall from grace.
neutralization: Cancelled if Jupiter aspects 10th.

formation: Three or more planets exalted or in own signs in Kendras or Konas.
effect: Elevates person to ruler, head of state, or chief executive status.

name: Vakra/Debilitated Raja Yoga
formation: Debilitated planet retrograde or bright, occupying favorable house.
effect: High position equal to a ruler, unexpected rise.
neutralization: Impaired if planet loses retrograde motion.

name: Digbala Raja Yoga
formation: Two to four planets possessing Digbala (directional strength).
effect: Rise from humble origin to high ruler status.
neutralization: Weakened if planets are combust.

name: Aquarius Exaltation Raja Yoga
formation: Aquarius Lagna with Venus in it and four planets exalted.
effect: Sovereign ruler status, supreme political authority.
neutralization: Specific to Aquarius Lagna.

name: Kendra Benefic Raja Yoga
formation: Moon in Lagna, Jupiter in 4th, Venus in 10th, Saturn exalted/own house.
effect: Ruler or chief executive of vast domain.
neutralization: Voided if Moon is waning/afflicted.

name: Neechabhanga Raja Yoga
formation: Dispositor of a debilitated planet (or its exaltation lord) in a Kendra from Lagna or Moon.
effect: Elevation from low birth or hardship to great fortune, power, and fame.
neutralization: Nullified if the dispositor is itself combust or in 8th house.
additional_info: Most famous cancellation-elevation yoga in Vedic astrology.

name: Chandra-Guru Raja Yoga
formation: Strong Moon in Kendra (other than Lagna) aspected by Jupiter.
effect: Power, wealth, high administrative influence.
neutralization: Impaired if Moon is waning.

name: Amsa Exaltation Raja Yoga
formation: Debilitated Rasi planets exalted in Navamsa.
effect: High administrative power, ruler status.
neutralization: Weakened if Navamsa dispositor is afflicted.

name: Tri-Kona Raja Yoga
formation: Jupiter in Lagna, Mercury in Kendra aspected by 9th/11th lords.
effect: High authority, prosperity, widespread respect.

effect: Landed lord, infrastructure titan, ruler status.

name: Chandra-Mangala-Rahu Raja Yoga
formation: Moon and Mars in 2nd/3rd with Rahu in 5th.
effect: Financial authority, commercial power.
neutralization: Weakened if Rahu is in fall.

name: Uttamamsa Raja Yoga
formation: 10th lord in 9th house in exalted/friendly Navamsa with Uttamamsa.
effect: High governance status, royal honor.
neutralization: Weakened if 10th lord is combust.

name: Gajakesari Fixed Lagna Raja Yoga
formation: Jupiter in 5th, Moon in Kendra from Jupiter, Fixed Lagna lord in 10th.
effect: Sovereign power, permanent political authority.
neutralization: Specific to fixed Lagnas.

formation: Navamsa dispositor of Moon in Kendra/Kona from Lagna/Mercury.
effect: Elevated social status, wealth, executive power.
neutralization: Weakened if dispositor is debilitated.

effect: Military commander, ruler, high defense executive.

effect: High status, political power through mass support.

effect: Respected leader, immense wealth, executive rank.
neutralization: Weakened if Jupiter is combust.

effect: Great statesmanship, ruler status, high fortune.
neutralization: Voided if benefic becomes combust.

name: Galakarna Yoga
formation: 3rd house occupied by Mandi and Rahu (or Mars in Preta Puriha Shashtiamsa).
effect: Severe ear afflictions, hearing impairment, otitis media.
neutralization: Cancelled if Jupiter aspects 3rd.

name: Vrana Yoga
formation: Malefic 6th lord placed in Lagna, 8th, or 10th house.
effect: Malignant tumors, cancer, severe ulceration.

formation: Mercury in Lagna combined with 6th and 8th lords.
effect: Incurable sexual/genital diseases, venereal afflictions.
neutralization: Mitigated by Venus aspect.

name: Kalatrashanda Yoga
formation: 7th lord placed in 6th house combined with Venus.
effect: Frigidity or sexual dysfunction of spouse.
neutralization: Cancelled by Jupiter aspect.

name: Kushtaroga Yoga 1
formation: Lagna lord with Mars/Mercury in 4th or 12th house.
effect: Leprosy, severe dermatological afflictions.
neutralization: Mitigated by benefic aspect.

formation: Jupiter, Saturn, and Moon placed together in 6th house.
effect: Chronic skin diseases, leprosy.
neutralization: Cancelled by Sun aspect.

name: Kshaya Roga Yoga
formation: Rahu in 6th, Mandi in Kendra, Lagna lord in 8th.
effect: Pulmonary tuberculosis, consumption, respiratory failure.
neutralization: Mitigated by strong Jupiter aspect.

name: Bandhana Yoga
formation: Lords of 1st and 6th in Kendra/Kona with Saturn, Rahu, or Kethu.
effect: Incarceration, imprisonment, hostage crisis, house arrest.
neutralization: Cancelled if 1st lord is exalted.

name: Karascheda Yoga
formation: Saturn in 9th and Jupiter in 3rd (or 8th/12th).
effect: Amputation or physical loss of hands/limbs.
neutralization: Cancelled by Venus aspect.

name: Sirachcheda Yoga
formation: 6th lord with Venus, Sun/Saturn with Rahu in cruel Shashtiamsa.
effect: Execution, beheading, hanging, fatal neck injury.
neutralization: Cancelled by Jupiter aspect.

name: Durmarana Yoga
formation: Moon in 6th, 8th, or 12th with Saturn/Mandi/Rahu aspected by Lagna lord.
effect: Unnatural death (suicide, poisoning, drowning, accident).
neutralization: Cancelled if Jupiter aspects Moon.

formation: 8th lord combined with Saturn and Rahu in 8th house.
effect: Mass disaster fatality.
neutralization: Mitigated by Jupiter aspect.

name: Pittaroga Yoga
formation: Sun in 6th house with a malefic, aspected by another malefic.
effect: Bilious complaints, liver disorders, Pitta imbalance.
neutralization: Cancelled by Jupiter aspect.

name: Vikalangapatni Yoga
formation: Sun and Venus placed together in 5th, 7th, or 9th house.
effect: Wife having deformed limbs or physical handicap.
neutralization: Cancelled by benefic aspect.

name: Putrakalatraheena Yoga
formation: Waning Moon in 5th, malefics in Lagna, 7th, and 12th.
effect: Deprivation of family and children, severe domestic isolation.
neutralization: Cancelled by Jupiter aspect on Lagna.

name: Bharyasahavyabhichara Yoga
formation: Venus, Saturn, and Mars joining Moon in 7th house.
effect: Mutual marital infidelity, complex extra-marital affairs.
neutralization: Cancelled by Jupiter aspect on 7th.

name: Vamsacheda Yoga
formation: Moon in 10th, Venus in 7th, malefics in 4th house.

formation: Moon with malefics in Cancer or Scorpio Navamsa.

formation: Malefic Lagna (Aries, Leo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Aquarius) aspected by malefics.

name: Nishturabhashi Yoga
formation: Moon in conjunction with Saturn.
effect: Harsh, blunt, cold, insensitive speech.

name: Rajabhrashta Yoga

neutralization: Cancelled if Jupiter aspects Aroodha Lagna.

name: Raja Yoga Bhanga 1
formation: Leo Lagna with Saturn exalted in Rasi but debilitated in Navamsa (Visakha 1st pada).

neutralization: Specific to Leo Lagna Visakha pada 1.
